info.title: pushover-notifications
info.description: The routes pushover-notifications serves. Every path is relative to the mount the host assigns, and the host serves this document rebased under it at <mount>/openapi.json.

post.description: Sends one message so a person can tell the account works, or, with a kind, the message of that type as its saved rule writes it: its title, text, priority, sound and picture, filled in with sample values and marked Test. A type that is switched off is sent too. For a camera picture it uses the first printer (by serial) with a camera chosen, and for a thumbnail the first printer with a print file on record. A picture that could not be got is reported in picture_problem and the text is sent without it. The host takes operate_resource on the module's instance before this is called. Refused with 409 NOT_CONFIGURED while pushover_token and pushover_user are empty, with 400 UNKNOWN_KIND for a type this module does not have, and with 502 SEND_FAILED, carrying Pushover's reason, when Pushover does not take it.

printer.description: The printer the sample was written for. Empty for the plain test.

picture.description: The picture that went with the message.

picture_problem.description: Why a picture the rule asks for did not go with the message. Empty when none was asked for or it went.

kind.description: The message type to test. Left out, the plain account test is sent.
